cases.name: Carla Lowe
cases.narrative: On 11/13/1983, her body was found in the area of the 1700 block of Depot Avenue in Broward County. Investigators with the Delray Beach Police Department reportedly said that she was waiting for a train at the local Amtrak station when he attacked, beat her to death, and ran her over with a car.
